name: Graphene

lattice.source: In-plane constant from graphite, Y. Baskin and L. Meyer, Phys. Rev. 100 (1955) 544; c is a vacuum padding convention, not a physical repeat.

terminations.description: Pristine basal plane; the only meaningful termination for a monolayer.

reconstructions.description: Intrinsic out-of-plane ripples of suspended graphene.
reconstructions.reference: J. C. Meyer et al., Nature 446 (2007) 60
reconstructions.note: Not generated in v0.1; thermal corrugation must come from finite-temperature dynamics.

density.conditions: areal mass density of one layer
density.source: derived from the lattice parameters in this file

band_gap.source: A. H. Castro Neto et al., Rev. Mod. Phys. 81 (2009) 109

band_gap_type.source: classification following the band-gap reference cited for this material

fermi_velocity.source: A. H. Castro Neto et al., Rev. Mod. Phys. 81 (2009) 109

work_function.source: Y.-J. Yu et al., Nano Lett. 9 (2009) 3430

bond_length.source: derived from the lattice parameters in this file

tb_hopping_pi.source: A. H. Castro Neto et al., Rev. Mod. Phys. 81 (2009) 109

references: A. H. Castro Neto, F. Guinea, N. M. R. Peres, K. S. Novoselov, A. K. Geim, Rev. Mod. Phys. 81 (2009) 109
provenance_note: Compiled by the Materia project from the cited primary sources.
